retainedReference.title: Charlottenburg Palace, copper dome and long wings

pictures.author: Carsten Steger
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1280px aerial: long pale palace, red ceramic hip roofs, open U-shaped southern forecourt, central copper dome/lantern and west Orangery/east New Wing. Western end building temporarily scaffolded; its permanent unseen facade is a restrained approximation. Detached garden buildings, forecourt equestrian statue, fountains/gardens and temporary scaffolding remain context.

pictures.author: Times
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1280px south front: pale yellow/off-white two-storey ranges, repeated tall windows/pediments, three central arched portals and noble windows, four front pilasters/columns and supported triangular pediment, octagonal windowed drum/clock, ribbed copper bell dome/oculi, open lantern and gilded Fortuna finial. Historic relief/figures are original simplified abstractions; no pixels or inscriptions copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Principal connected Charlottenburg Palace exterior, including the open southern forecourt/main ranges, western Orangery and end pavilion, eastern New Wing, red ceramic hip roofs/dormers/stacks, pale repeated facades, central three arched recessed portals/thresholds, tall noble windows and supported triangular pediment. Mapped octagonal tower supports a windowed drum/clock, ribbed copper bell dome/oculi, open lantern/cap and an original schematic gilded Fortuna finial. Independent garden/campus buildings, forecourt statue, gardens/fountains and temporary scaffolding remain context. No furnished rooms or copied faces, reliefs, arms or inscriptions.
